lisa_support: Customer C raised a p99 API latency spike from eu-west starting ~07:55 UTC. Customer shows TLS handshake spikes (450-700ms) and some traces with cross-az hops. They reported failures around 08:10. Anyone oncall?

mike_sre: On it. Can you paste a sample request id / probe? Also, any recent infra changes in eu-west?

lisa_support: Sample request ids: req_9832, req_9837. Customer sent curl --trace timings: handshake ~0.45-0.7s, then quick transfer. Uploaded pcap+curl trace to s3: s3://redwood-support/pcaps/custC-2026-03-17-08-12.pcap

mike_sre: Running internal probe now from probe-eu1 -> edge-eu-west-pop. Traceroute snapshot:

traceroute to api.redwood.example (1.2.3.4), 30 hops max:
 1  10.1.0.1  0.57 ms  0.48 ms  0.52 ms
 2  192.0.2.5  1.2 ms  0.98 ms  1.05 ms
 3  203.0.113.12  12.3 ms  12.6 ms  12.9 ms
 4  198.51.100.7  120.4 ms  118.9 ms  121.7 ms  <-- jump to us-west hop
 5  1.2.3.4  119.8 ms  120.1 ms  119.9 ms

mike_sre: That 120ms cross-hop looks like hairpinning through a us-west backbone for some prefixes. TLS handshake breakdown from edge logs:

`grep handshake /var/log/edge/eu-west/tls.log | tail -n 5`
2026-03-17T07:56:02Z req=req_9829 handshake_time_ms=512 cert_verify_ms=12
2026-03-17T07:56:46Z req=req_9832 handshake_time_ms=697 cert_verify_ms=10
2026-03-17T08:02:11Z req=req_9837 handshake_time_ms=456 cert_verify_ms=9

adele: I pushed a GSLB weight tweak at 07:48 for a canary (small percentage to new hw group). Looking at metrics, weight rebalance completed ~07:50 and some prefixes were routed via us-west aggregator briefly. Could explain the hairpin. Rolling back the canary to restore previous weights.

ingress-bot: Deployment 2026-03-17T07:48:12Z: gslb-weight-update by adele succeeded (change-id: chg-7721).

jordan_prod: Short-term mitigation options: 1) pin affected customer prefix to region affinity (eu-west1-pop) for 15m, 2) decrease GSLB TTL to 30s so we can iterate faster, 3) add TLS handshake timeout backoff on SDK side. Any objections?

mike_sre: Doing (1) and (2) now. `routectl pin --prefix 203.0.113.0/24 --pop eu-west1-pop --ttl 900 --note "custC mitigation"` then set GSLB TTL to 30s: `gslbctl set-ttl 30`. Applying...

mike_sre: Applied pin + TTL change. Monitoring p95/p99 in the next 5m.

lisa_support: Customer reports p99 dropping from ~650ms -> ~120ms on latest check. They say failures stopped. :thumbsup:

adele: Confirmed rollback of canary weights at 07:55. I'll open a follow-up ticket to add a cooldown to the weight controller so small canaries don't cause cross-az hairpins. Also propose adding an egress-pref affinity to GSLB decisions for low-latency prefixes.

jordan_prod: Good. Action items:
- adele: PR for weight-controller cooldown + canary safety checks
- mike_sre: run full repro for cross-pop hairpin and add unit test for route affinity
- lisa_support: send a short incident note to customer + ops summary

mike_sre: Attaching short debug snippet for RCA: `edge->gslb logs show prefix 203.0.113.0/24 moved to aggregator-usw for 4m; TLS handshake median jumped during that window`. I'll keep monitoring for 30m.

lisa_support: Thanks team. Reopening if latency returns.
